title: Abbas tere baad
body:
Abbas tere baad
Haye abbas - 4
<<MINI>>
Abbas tere baad sitam ye bhi hua hai
Abbas sitam ye bhi hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Masoom sakina ka bhi rassi me gala hai
<<MINI>>
Abbas tere baad sitam ye bhi hua hai
Abbas sitam ye bhi hua hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis haal me haaye hai bhare ghar ki dulaari
Khaati hai tamache shahe mazloom ki pyaari
Hoton pe faqat x 2 haaye chacha haaye Chacha hai
Che maah ke asgar ne sitam kitne uthaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanhi si lahad khod ke sar kaata hai haaye
Do baar x 2 laaeno ne ise qatl kiya hai
Gardan me gara tauk hai aur paao me langar
Is haal me kaato pe chalate hai sitamgar
<<DIVIDER>>
Beemar ko x 2 haasil na dawa hai na giza hai
Har saas aziyat hai aziyat hi aziyat
Har gaam qayamat hai qayamat hi qayamat
Zainab ko x 2 mayassar na amaari na rida hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaano me mere rassiya kuffar ne daali
Sadqe ki khajure bhi meri samt uchaali
Sadaat pe x 2 kya waqt qayamat ka pada hai
Aabid ka koi haath batane nahi aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tanha hi sakina ke janaze ko uthaya
Har saas pe x 2 sau baar wo mar mar ke jiya hai
Wo chaalo bhare paao wo kaato bhari raahe
shabbir ke maqsad pe hai aabid ki nigahe
<<DIVIDER>>
Zanjeer ka x 2 shikwa hai naa durro ka gila hai
Dil hai ke sambhalta hi nahi meesumo fakhri
Mausam ye badalta hi nahi meesamo fakhri
Barsaat hai x 2 ashko ki to maatam ki ghata hai
